description: Values or formulas into several A1 ranges in one call (values.batchUpdate). Returns the cells updated per range (and what they now show, with include_values). write_range is the one-range variant that returns what the cells held before.

account.description: Which account this writes as: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Required; writes have no default.

data_filter.description: Instead of range: a DataFilter (see get_values).

range.description: An A1 range naming its sheet, e.g. "Sheet1!A2:C4".

values.description: Rows of cells (columns with major_dimension COLUMNS). null leaves a cell as it is; "" empties it.

include_values.description: Return the written cells as Sheets now renders them.

spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet's id, or its URL.

value_input.description: USER_ENTERED parses as if typed ("=SUM(A:A)" a formula, "2026-10-08" a date, "12.5" a number); RAW stores strings as text.

name: update_values
title: Write cell values
